ev.q: Using two HEPA air cleaners close to the aerosol source reduced the aerosol exposure
the total aerosol mass concentration was averaged over 60 minutes
The reductions with the air cleaners in the center floor position were higher than those
Efficacy of Portable Air Cleaners and Masking for Reducing Indoor Exposure to Simulated Exhaled SARS-CoV-2 Aerosols

methods_quotes.q: All data were analyzed using the Kruskal Wallis test to assess overall significance
followed by a Wilcoxon Rank Sum pairwise comparison with a Benjamini and Hochberg adjusted p-value
the total aerosol mass concentration was averaged over 60 minutes
Each experiment was repeated four times for a total of 20 tests.
